title: Maker keepers: auction participation economics

sources.sourceRole: Primary publication; account may be retrospective or interested-party

documentedClaim: Keeper implementation documents auction types, gas escalation and inventory management.
inferredMechanism: Participation costs and operational availability can shape auction competition and realized proceeds.
counterevidence: Software documentation is not a profitability record; modern code is not proof of historical auction behavior.
transferRequirements: Pin historical contract and code versions; account for reverted transactions, gas, competition and inventory. Do not deploy a keeper.
outcomeBoundary: Public narrative already inspected; described cases are discovery examples, never untouched confirmation. No experimental market outcome dataset opened.
